Step 15: one index primer into sub_1 through in_s1. Each chamber gets its own, which is what tells the four sublibraries apart after sequencing. It also pushes the capsules left in the fill line into the chamber.

Step 15: PCR mix into sub_1. The fill line keeps its own volume as dead space, so the mix volume includes it. Capillary-stop vents let air out and hold the liquid, so the four reactions stay isolated.
